title: 航空宇宙工学入門とキャリアデザイン
subtitle: Introduction to Aerospace Engineering and Career Design
teachers:
HAMAMOTO Yusuke
授業科目の学習・教育目標
keywords: Technologies Related to Aircraft and Spacecraft
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn about current and future technologies supporting the modern world.
(2) learn to think for oneself.
(3) establish a learning posture conducive to developing their future career.
(4) learn to think about the essence of phenomena and objects and to think about things logically.
(5) learn the ability to design in their major engineering field.
advice:
This is an introduction to engineering as it relates to aeronautics and astronautics. The objectives of this subject are shown below.

1. Understanding of the system of the Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics
2. Understanding the Role of Aircraft and Spacecraft-Related Technologies in Society
3. Obtaining the ability to investigate the essence of phenomena and objects through suitable exercises
4. Introduction to the research field
5. General exercises

Students should learn the relationship between engineering and society and the role of engineers.
Student should understand the importance of basic knowledge and attain a self-driven attitude toward learning in the department of aeronautics and astronautics.
The level of students’ achievement will be evaluated through reports and presentations with a view of their ability to convert their knowledge into practice.
requiredKnowledge:
Selection of an area of interest in engineering
Attitude of autonomy
It is also important to utilize AI and open data as assistance to own learning.
